releases.release_notes_markdown:
## What's Changed

* Rewritten events system
  * Voting and other commands are no longer tied to the discord integration.
  * Players in game can vote without the host having to set up discord
* In-game chat now shows when players join and leave
* Improved stability via safer access to critical game internals
* Discord integration now gets an event log
* Discord integration now tracks map changes and server starts
* In-game server messages are now less obnoxious
* Command improvements
  * Commands now always accessible
  * Type `!help` in game or in the related discord channel to see available commands
* Voting improvements
  * Vote speed 
    * Players can vote for game speed by entering `!vote speed <speed-in-percent>`. This allows users to switch to fast speed and slomo
  * Vote restart-server
    * Players can vote to restart the server if they are noticing degraded performance, or think things aren't working right
    
## PRs

* Generalized event system by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/60
* Fix player count by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/61
* Leave events by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/62
* Reconfigurable discord, event log subscriber, enhanced damage events, cleaned up discord cli args by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/63


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/compare/v1.0.0-rc0...v1.0.0-RC1
